snippet.title: Saloon Simulator – Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🥃 Get ready to pour drinks, upgrade your saloon, and survive the wild Wild West!

Saloon Simulator officially launches on July 15th on Steam!
Build your own bar, serve customers, mix drinks, deal with troublemakers and become a legend of the frontier.

👉 Add to your Wishlist now: https://cutt.ly/cwR4Lcuv
